title: An adjunction unit telescope detects equality at a scalar power
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a preadditive category [def-weil-preadditive-category], let $\mathcal B$ be a category, and fix an adjunction $F:\mathcal A\rightleftarrows\mathcal B:U$ with unit $\eta$ (thus $\operatorname{Hom}(FA,T)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A,UT)$ naturally). Fix $a\in\mathbf N$ and objects $K,B\in\mathcal A$. Let $t$ be a cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] on the sequence $B\xrightarrow{a\operatorname{id}}B\to\cdots$, with vertex $UFB$ and zeroth leg $\eta_B$. Suppose that postcomposition with its legs exhibits $\operatorname{Hom}(K,UFB)$ as the colimit in abelian groups of the sequence $\operatorname{Hom}(K,B)\xrightarrow{a}\operatorname{Hom}(K,B)\to\cdots$. Then, for any $f,g:K\to B$, the equality $F(f)=F(g)$ implies $a^nf=a^ng$ for some $n\geq0$. All sequences are indexed by a small copy of $\mathbf N$.
